description: This is a Java test class for the Apache Fineract project, specifically testing global configuration functionalities via integration tests. It uses JUnit 5, RestAssured for HTTP requests, and references various classes and constants related to global configurations in Fineract.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for verifying global configuration features in the Fineract system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured settings, request and response specifications, and the helper object before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets and verifies default configurations after each test.

methods.name: testGlobalConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves all global configuration details and asserts that the response is not null.

methods.name: testGlobalConfigurationUpdate
methods.description: Fetches a specific configuration, updates its value and enabled status, verifies the updates, and then restores the original settings.

methods.name: testGetConfigurationPropertyById
methods.description: Retrieves a global configuration by ID and asserts that its name is not blank.

methods.name: testNotExistingConfigurationProperty
methods.description: Attempts to fetch a non-existent configuration, expects an exception, and verifies the response code is 404.

methods.name: testPasswordUpdateFailing
methods.description: Tests that updating password reset configuration with an invalid value leads to an expected failure with proper error message and code.
